privacy.title: How we protect real-name details
privacy.intro: To protect participants, challenges that ask for real-name details come with several safeguards:
privacy.anonymousBody: Everyday activity on the platform stays anonymous, so other users never see a participant's real identity
privacy.purposeBody: Real-name details are used only where they are needed: verification, credits and awards
privacy.encryptionBody: Real-name details are stored and sent with end-to-end encryption, so unauthorised access is impossible
privacy.accessBody: Every access to real-name details is logged, and participants can review the log at any time
privacy.verificationBody: Verify who a participant is, so mentors know their background
privacy.certificationBody: Used to issue certificates and award credits once a challenge closes
privacy.awardsBody: Used to judge prizes and select projects once a challenge closes
privacy.commitmentBody: As a challenge publisher, follow the privacy rules strictly and view real-name details only where necessary. Every view is logged, and misuse is penalised.
